versions.content: API Function Header File Description Can If _ - Transmit Fr If.h Requests transmission of a PDU. Det _ Report - Error Det.h Service to report development errors. Fr If _ Disable - L Pdu Fr If.h Wraps the Flex Ray Driver Function Fr_ Disable LPdu. It disables the hardware resource of an LPdu for transmission/ reception. Fr If _ - Reconfig L - Pdu Fr If.h Calls the Flex Ray Driver's API Fr_ Reconfig LPdu. The enum value "FR_ CHANNEL_ AB" shall not be used. Fr If _ - Transmit Fr If.h Requests transmission of a PDU. Get Counter - Value Os.h This service reads the current count value of a counter (returning either the hardware timer ticks if counter is driven by hardware or the software ticks when user drives counter). Get Elapsed - Value Os.h This service gets the number of ticks between the current tick value and a previously read tick value. So Ad _ If - Transmit So Ad.h Requests transmission of a PDU.
